correctness.rationale: The projection classification follows from endpoint transpositions, vertex mean-zero normalization, and the three tensor identities m(a+nb)=1, n(c+md)=1, ma+nc=1. P_t is a true cut projection; Q_t=I-P_t^T, crucially not I-P_t, is a true cycle projection. Exact signed row/column counts yield four convex piecewise-linear norm objectives. On [0,1] the opposing affine branches cross at interior rational parameters. Exterior minimizers are excluded by clipping for cut and convex supporting slopes for cycle. Positive factorization proves strict endpoint separations. Packaged exact-rational checker passed 28,641 assertions, including idempotence and zero divergence; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The rook graph is a canonical two-parameter Cartesian graph metric with Banach-relevant cut and cycle kernels. Unlike the equal-axis family, unequal axes have four distinct norm-minimizing equivariant projection choices and provably opposite strict ℓ1-versus-ℓ∞ gaps for cut and cycle spaces. These exact natural projection invariants, all-dimensional formulae, and a nonorthogonality obstruction are motivated structural information, not merely one more finite example.
